evidence: Kernel-checked separation of connected fibres from extendable step lifting, and a physical repair with temporary boundary motion.
proved: For every finite graph and palette, any two proper colourings agreeing outside two vertices are Kempe connected without touching that exterior.
A nine-vertex four-colour graph has connected restriction fibres but an actual retained component move to an extendable target has no full lift with six leaves fixed.
The same witness refutes the joint-operation on-image lifting contract without independence.
Three full component switches reach the target when one boundary leaf may change temporarily. All other leaves stay fixed and the full boundary is restored at the endpoint.
scope: Refutes a specified boundary-fixed lifting contract on arbitrary finite graphs. Degree-one leaves do not satisfy minimal-counterexample geometry; no Lean planarity or embedding theorem is claimed for this example. Temporary context motion requires compatibility with any larger exterior. No impossibility of compact compositional proofs follows.
